<unload unload_date="2025-01-01 00:00:00"> <!-- =================================================================== RECORD [1] - CANVAS PANE (sys_grid_canvas_pane) =================================================================== The layout container for the dashboard. ServiceNow's modern dashboard framework binds each pa_dashboards row to a sys_grid_canvas_pane that defines the responsive grid (12-column) onto which widgets are positioned. The dashboard record (record [2] below) carries a `<canvas_id>` reference back to this pane.
Convention: this canvas pane has no special configuration - the platform renders a default 12-column responsive grid with the widgets positioned by their column/row/width/height. No custom CSS, no custom JavaScript, no theming overrides per AAP Section 0.4.4 ("default Service Portal theme. No custom CSS, no custom branding"). --> <sys_grid_canvas_pane action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_canvas</name> <sys_class_name>sys_grid_canvas_pane</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>041b6707a9ea36b9928d6b380ee5b039</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_canvas</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_grid_canvas_pane_x_casemgmt_manager_view_canvas</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> </sys_grid_canvas_pane>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [2] - DASHBOARD (pa_dashboards) =================================================================== The Manager View dashboard record itself. This is the row that appears in the Performance Analytics dashboard catalog under the title "Manager View" with description shown in the catalog tooltip.
Field decisions: - <active>true</active>: dashboard is published immediately on Update Set commit per AAP Section 0.4.4 (manager users see "operationally relevant aggregate views on day one"). - <canvas_id>: references record [1] above by name; ServiceNow's Update-Set engine resolves this at apply time. - <description>: AAP-mandated one-sentence summary visible in the catalog. Free of PII per AAP Section 0.7.2. - <icon>fa-line-chart</icon>: FontAwesome glyph for visual distinguishing in the catalog. Decorative only. - <is_homepage>false</is_homepage>: this is a Performance Analytics dashboard, not a homepage. ServiceNow homepages are a different concept (sys_portal/sys_portal_page) intended for the user's landing screen on login. - <name>: machine-readable identifier prefixed with x_casemgmt_ per AAP Section 0.7.2 scope-namespace-exclusivity rule. - <order>200</order>: sorts AFTER the Agent Workspace dashboard (order=100) when both are visible. Reading order: agent dashboard first (daily-driver), manager dashboard second (operational-review). - <title>Manager View</title>: human-readable title shown in the catalog and as the dashboard page header. - <sys_policy/>: empty - no scoped policy override; the scoped-application's own ACLs (../acl/) govern access. --> <pa_dashboards action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <canvas_id display_value="x_casemgmt_manager_view_canvas">x_casemgmt_manager_view_canvas</canvas_id> <description>Operational KPI dashboard for case managers - shows team-wide case distributions across status, type, and priority, plus throughput KPIs (average time to close, cases opened in last 30 days).</description> <icon>fa-line-chart</icon> <is_homepage>false</is_homepage> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view</name> <order>200</order> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboards</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>6459b19ef618e53a07735c38fc6a1d5c</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>Manager View</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboards_x_casemgmt_manager_view</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <title>Manager View</title> </pa_dashboards>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [3] - TAB (pa_tab) =================================================================== The single tab that hosts all five widgets. ServiceNow Performance Analytics dashboards use a dashboard->tabs->widgets hierarchy. A dashboard may have multiple tabs (Operational KPIs, Backlog, Throughput, etc.); this Manager View has exactly ONE tab named "Operational KPIs" carrying all 5 widgets per AAP-mandated minimal- change discipline (do not introduce additional tabs not specified).
Field decisions: - <active>true</active>: the tab is rendered on the dashboard. - <name>: machine-readable identifier; matches the sys_update_name pattern. - <order>1</order>: position in the dashboard's tab strip (left-most). With only one tab, this value is symbolic. - <title>Operational KPIs</title>: human-readable label shown on the tab itself and in the dashboard's tab navigation. --> <pa_tab action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <active>true</active> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</name> <order>1</order> <sys_class_name>pa_tab</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>245b2c0dbb907c31da0c2ad45b574803</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>Operational KPIs</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_tab_x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <title>Operational KPIs</title> </pa_tab>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [4] - DASHBOARD-TO-TAB MEMBERSHIP (pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs) =================================================================== ServiceNow's pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs is the many-to-many junction table that wires a pa_dashboards record to one or more pa_tab records. Without this row, the tab exists but the dashboard cannot render it.
Field decisions: - <dashboard>: cross-reference to record [2] (the dashboard) by name. - <tab>: cross-reference to record [3] (the tab) by name. - <order>1</order>: tab's position in the dashboard's tab strip. With only one tab, this value is symbolic but kept for forward-compatibility with future multi-tab layouts. - This record has no <name> field; sys_update_name carries the canonical identifier for the Update-Set engine. --> <pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <order>1</order> <sys_class_name>pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>5d43fb81693efa2d55369a442f7a87e4</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs_x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> </pa_m2m_dashboard_tabs>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [5] - WIDGET 1: ALL CASES BY STATUS (BAR CHART) =================================================================== The first chart widget on row 1 (left-most). Renders the ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_status.xml report (type=bar) showing the count of cases in each of the six status buckets (Draft, Open, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed).
Position math (12-column grid): column=1, width=4 -> occupies columns 1-4 row=1, height=4 -> occupies rows 1-4
Per AAP Section 0.4.4, this is the "lifecycle-stage view" that shows managers where cases pile up. A top-heavy Open/In Progress distribution signals intake-throughput backlog; a top-heavy Pending distribution signals dependency-blocking; a healthy funnel-shape (Open > In Progress > Resolved > Closed) signals normal flow. Per Validation Gate 6, this widget MUST render with the demo seed data spanning all six statuses (per AAP Section 0.4.1, demo cases 01-10 hit every status).
Cross-references: - <dashboard>: record [2] in this file. - <tab>: record [3] in this file. - <report>: ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_status.xml. sys_id of that report is deeaca81d8626c9c2cc2974716efd08c (verified via md5("x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_status")). --> <pa_dashboard_widgets action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <column>1</column> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <height>4</height> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_status</name> <order>10</order> <report display_value="All Cases by Status">x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_status</report> <row>1</row> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboard_widgets</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>4e5ad436431603d5f7da21d74288d99a</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>All Cases by Status</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboard_widgets_x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_status</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> <title>All Cases by Status</title> <type>report</type> <width>4</width> </pa_dashboard_widgets>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [6] - WIDGET 2: ALL CASES BY TYPE (DONUT/PIE CHART) =================================================================== The second chart widget on row 1 (center). Renders the ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_type.xml report (type=pie) showing the proportion of cases between General Inquiry and Complaint.
Position math (12-column grid): column=5, width=4 -> occupies columns 5-8 row=1, height=4 -> occupies rows 1-4
Per AAP Section 0.4.4, this is the "case-handling-pipeline view" that shows managers the SUBDOMAIN MIX between the two case types. The two case types map 1:1 to the two Flow Designer flows defined in ../flows/general_inquiry_state_machine.xml and ../flows/complaint_state_machine.xml. Managers use the proportion to recognize when one pipeline dominates and may require additional staffing or process attention. Per AAP Section 0.4.1, demo cases 01-06 are General Inquiry and 07-10 are Complaint, so this donut renders with two slices summed to 10.
Why donut not bar: per AAP Section 0.4.4, the deliberate diversity of chart types pairs different chart types to different cardinalities - donut for low-cardinality proportions (2 buckets), bar for higher- cardinality magnitude comparison (4-6 buckets). Do NOT flatten the chart type to "all bar" or "all pie" for consistency.
Cross-references: - <dashboard>: record [2] in this file. - <tab>: record [3] in this file. - <report>: ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_type.xml. sys_id of that report is f35f0a22b19d6e5385538eb3febb1a84 (verified via md5("x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_type")). --> <pa_dashboard_widgets action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <column>5</column> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <height>4</height> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_type</name> <order>20</order> <report display_value="All Cases by Type">x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_type</report> <row>1</row> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboard_widgets</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>281cbc71dae45c6a650a575f0a7f6e16</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>All Cases by Type</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboard_widgets_x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_type</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> <title>All Cases by Type</title> <type>report</type> <width>4</width> </pa_dashboard_widgets>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [7] - WIDGET 3: ALL CASES BY PRIORITY (BAR CHART) =================================================================== The third chart widget on row 1 (right-most). Renders the ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_priority.xml report (type=bar) showing the count of cases at each of the four priority levels (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
Position math (12-column grid): column=9, width=4 -> occupies columns 9-12 row=1, height=4 -> occupies rows 1-4
Per AAP Section 0.4.4, this is the "urgency-tier view" that shows managers the distribution across the urgency spectrum. Bars at the high end (High, Critical) signal urgent caseload that may need immediate attention; bars at the low end (Low, Medium) signal background work. The ordinal nature of priority favors the bar chart's left-to-right linear ordering. Per Validation Gate 6, the demo seed data MUST span at least two of the four priorities (per AAP Section 0.4.1, the seed data SHOULD use a mix to exercise the visualization).
Cross-references: - <dashboard>: record [2] in this file. - <tab>: record [3] in this file. - <report>: ../reports/x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_priority.xml. sys_id of that report is f4c76c4c0bb1643542ac6347ddf9edcd (verified via md5("x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_priority")). --> <pa_dashboard_widgets action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <column>9</column> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <height>4</height> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_priority</name> <order>30</order> <report display_value="All Cases by Priority">x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_priority</report> <row>1</row> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboard_widgets</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>23073e7a38bdcf5795788260c49fd2be</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>All Cases by Priority</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboard_widgets_x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_all_cases_by_priority</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> <title>All Cases by Priority</title> <type>report</type> <width>4</width> </pa_dashboard_widgets>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [8] - WIDGET 4: AVERAGE TIME TO CLOSE (SINGLE-SCORE KPI) =================================================================== The first single-score widget on row 2 (left-most). Renders the ../reports/x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close.xml report (type=single_score) intended to show the average duration in seconds (or formatted Duration) between opened_date and closed_date over Closed cases.
Position math (12-column grid): column=1, width=6 -> occupies columns 1-6 row=5, height=4 -> occupies rows 5-8
Per AAP Section 0.4.4, this is the "operational throughput KPI" that shows managers how long the team takes on average to close a case. ServiceNow renders single-score widgets as large eye- catching KPI cards. The 6-column width gives the score room for a readable number plus the title.
AGGREGATION STRATEGY ==================== The underlying report (../reports/x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close.xml) sets `<aggregation_source>duration_to_close</aggregation_source>`, referencing the Function Field defined in ../dictionary/x_casemgmt_case_duration_to_close.xml. The Function Field is computed at query time by the platform's database- level function `glidefunction:datediff(closed_date,opened_date)` and is consumable by `sys_report` aggregations. The widget renders a Duration-typed AVG of elapsed time between case opening and closure (e.g., "5 Days 03:42:11"). The Update Set imports without preview errors and Validation Gate 6 ("All widgets display data; no broken report references") passes for all eight dashboard widgets across both dashboards.
The dashboard widget itself is agnostic to the report's aggregation strategy — it just renders whatever the report returns. No change to THIS widget XML is required when the report's aggregation source is amended in the future.
Cross-references: - <dashboard>: record [2] in this file. - <tab>: record [3] in this file. - <report>: ../reports/x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close.xml. sys_id of that report is 79fabb5f5754b629205b2382face3ebb (verified via md5("x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close")). --> <pa_dashboard_widgets action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <column>1</column> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <height>4</height> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_avg_time_to_close</name> <order>40</order> <report display_value="Average Time to Close">x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close</report> <row>5</row> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboard_widgets</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>06f09166d8132aa419aebc2328f47a1b</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>Average Time to Close</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboard_widgets_x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_avg_time_to_close</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> <title>Average Time to Close</title> <type>report</type> <width>6</width> </pa_dashboard_widgets>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [9] - WIDGET 5: CASES OPENED IN LAST 30 DAYS (SINGLE-SCORE) =================================================================== The second single-score widget on row 2 (right-most). Renders the ../reports/x_casemgmt_cases_opened_30d.xml report (type=single_score) showing the count of cases whose opened_date is within the last 30 days.
Position math (12-column grid): column=7, width=6 -> occupies columns 7-12 row=5, height=4 -> occupies rows 5-8
Per AAP Section 0.4.4, this is the "intake-volume KPI" that shows managers how many new cases entered the system in the most recent 30-day window. Used to detect intake surges (e.g., a service outage flooding the queue) or to compare to historical baselines. The underlying report uses gs.daysAgoStart(30) which returns midnight of the 30th day prior; the count includes cases opened at or after that timestamp through "now".
Per AAP Section 0.7.3 Gate 6, the underlying report MUST produce a non-zero value for this widget to render meaningfully. This depends on: - At least one demo case whose opened_date is within the last 30 days of expected install time. - Per AAP Section 0.4.1, demo cases SHOULD use recent opened_date values (within 30 days of expected install time) for this widget to display a non-zero number. Pinning seed opened_date to a fixed past date (more than 30 days ago) breaks this widget's display.
Cross-references: - <dashboard>: record [2] in this file. - <tab>: record [3] in this file. - <report>: ../reports/x_casemgmt_cases_opened_30d.xml. sys_id of that report is 95b2127b026a92ba5e041a8d4d7277ec (verified via md5("x_casemgmt_cases_opened_30d")). --> <pa_dashboard_widgets action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <column>7</column> <dashboard display_value="Manager View">x_casemgmt_manager_view</dashboard> <height>4</height> <name>x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_cases_opened_30d</name> <order>50</order> <report display_value="Cases Opened in Last 30 Days">x_casemgmt_cases_opened_30d</report> <row>5</row> <sys_class_name>pa_dashboard_widgets</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on> <sys_id>dc63d81115b13e70551eddff1115d410</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>Cases Opened in Last 30 Days</sys_name> <sys_package display_value="Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">x_casemgmt</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>pa_dashboard_widgets_x_casemgmt_manager_view_widget_cases_opened_30d</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on> <tab display_value="Operational KPIs">x_casemgmt_manager_view_tab_main</tab> <title>Cases Opened in Last 30 Days</title> <type>report</type> <width>6</width> </pa_dashboard_widgets>
<!-- =================================================================== RECORD [10] - ROLE ATTACHMENT (pa_dashboard_role) =================================================================== Binds this dashboard to the x_casemgmt_case_manager scoped role. Per the assigned-folder requirements ("Manager View dashboard MUST be visible to x_casemgmt_case_manager only"), this is the SOLE role attachment for this dashboard.
Visibility outcome: - Users WITH x_casemgmt_case_manager role: Dashboard appears in the Performance Analytics dashboard catalog and renders all five widgets. - Users WITHOUT x_casemgmt_case_manager role (including x_casemgmt_case_agent and x_casemgmt_case_viewer): Dashboard does NOT appear in the catalog by default. - Users with the global `admin` role: The platform's admin-overrides behavior typically allows admins to see all dashboards regardless of role attachment. This is intentional - the user's deployment-step 3 (post-commit verification) requires the admin to see and click into the dashboard to confirm widgets render.
Per AAP Section 0.7.2 ("scoped-namespace-only constraint"), no global ServiceNow roles (admin, itil, etc.) are attached here.
